highlights: Automated clinical chart review query pipeline
Fetches historical radiology and pathology reports by chart number
Exports multi-year patient records into tabular review spreadsheets

name: UserScript_Path_Converter
intro: Development path switcher for Seahorse and Greasemonkey userscripts, transforming local file URLs to workstation network paths.
highlights: Development path switcher for Seahorse and Greasemonkey userscripts
Transforms local development URLs to network workstation paths
Facilitates rapid testing and deployment of hospital web extensions

name: LiuWordList
intro: Automated dictionary reverse-engineering script for the Boshiamy (嘸蝦米) input method. Sequentially steps through candidate grids to dump mappings.
highlights: Automated reverse-engineering utility for the Boshiamy input method
Sequentially navigates input candidate grids to dump character code mappings
Generates raw word tables for custom input method engines
